README – Krea2 LoRA I2I v4
widgets_values:
## Krea-2 Turbo + LoRA — I2I v4

**Model:** krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled · qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled (type krea2) · qwen_image_vae. LoRA: Ivan_Ryo 1.15 · briefs-kreas2 1.0 (cho token quần lót random) · sweatySkin / shavedMalePubes tắt. 8 bước, euler/simple, CFG 1.

**Luồng:** Ảnh + prompt (tay / folder) → **Krea2 Prompt Builder v4** (giống T2I v4) → **7 Random swap** → **Krea2 Sampler I2I** → Save A1111.

**⚡ Dùng folder batch?** — 1 toggle đổi nguồn cho cả ảnh lẫn prompt. Bật: *ImageBatch* (folder ảnh + .txt cùng tên, *Start Auto Batch* chạy hết folder). Tắt: *Ảnh tay* + *Prompt tay*.

**Thứ tự prompt cuối:** `MainTrigger` → `Prefix` → prompt đã xử lý → `Suffix` (nối bằng `. `), rồi mọi từ `brief|briefs|underwear|towel|pants|sweatpants|shorts|sweatshorts` (kể cả trong Suffix) thành **1** token random từ *7a*.

**Switcher:** `refine` (Qwen3-VL-4B viết lại; lỗi/từ chối → prompt gốc) · `nsfw` (system prompt NSFW, bỏ qua lớp chặn SFW). Qwen **không** nhìn ảnh — chỉ viết lại chữ của .txt / Prompt tay.

**Krea2 Prompt Builder v4** (double-click để mở): 1 Nguồn · 2 `{char}` · 3 LLM refine (2 system prompt ở trên) · 4 Dọn output LLM · 5 Ép identity LoRA · S Chặn SFW (khi `nsfw` tắt: xoá chữ khoả thân, thêm câu che hông) · 6 Ghép. Bảng regex: note *Regex – bảng tra*.

**Krea2 Sampler I2I:** ảnh → scale theo `megapixels` → VAE Encode → KSampler → Decode. **`denoise`** chỉnh trên node: 0.5 giữ ảnh gốc nhiều, 0.75 vẽ lại nhiều.

**Lưu:** `Krea2_<ngày>/Krea2_I2I_v4_<yyMMdd>_<MainTrigger>_<ImageBatch.index>_<Seed>` — index đếm từ 0.

nodes.title: Regex – bảng tra
widgets_values:
## Regex – bảng tra (R = chỉ khi refine bật, A = luôn chạy)

| Node | Tìm | Thay | Mục đích | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2a | chữ MainTrigger | `{char}` | trigger trong .txt → `{char}` | A |
| 4a | `^[\s\S]*</think>\s*` · `</?think>` | rỗng | cắt suy luận thinking | R |
| 4b | dòng "Here is…:" · `**` · `---` · `#` · gạch đầu dòng | rỗng | câu dẫn / markdown | R |
| 4c | xuống dòng | 1 dấu cách | 1 đoạn | R |
| 4d | nhãn đầu "Final Output:", "Prompt:"… | rỗng | bỏ nhãn | R |
| 4f | rỗng · I'm sorry · I can't · as an AI · chép system prompt… | (đúng/sai) | lỗi → dùng prompt gốc | R |
| 5a | xuống dòng | 1 dấu cách | 1 đoạn (cả khi refine tắt) | A |
| 5b | màu/độ dài trong 4 từ trước `hair` (trừ khi có light/rim/glow trước `hair`) | `short ` | LoRA giữ tóc | A |
| 5c | `short` thừa trước `hair` (kể cả `short, short`) | rỗng | gộp short short | A |
| 5d | sharp/defined/strong… + jawline/chin/cheekbones/nose | rỗng | LoRA giữ mặt | A |
| 5e | ` ,` · `,,` · ` .` | rỗng | dọn dấu phẩy | A |
| 5f | 2+ dấu cách | 1 dấu cách | dọn khoảng trắng | A |
| S1 | nude/naked/penis/testicles/pubic hair/erection/buttocks/erotic (+ tính từ, mạo từ đi trước) | rỗng | chặn SFW | nsfw tắt |
| S2 | `, ,` · ` ;` · khoảng trắng thừa | rỗng | dọn sau S1 | nsfw tắt |
| S3 | "cover(s) the groin" · "groin is covered/hidden/out of frame" | (đúng/sai) | đã có câu che? | nsfw tắt |
| S4–S5 | — | + `He wears briefs that fully cover the groin.` | thêm câu che nếu thiếu | nsfw tắt |
| 6a | `{char}` đứng riêng đầu thân | rỗng | trigger đã đứng đầu | A |
| 6b | `{char}'s` đầu thân | `His` | giữ chủ ngữ | A |
| 6c | `{char}` + chữ thường đầu thân | `He ` | giữ chủ ngữ | A |
| 6d | `{char}` | MainTrigger | `{char}` giữa câu | A |
| 7b | brief/briefs/underwear/towel/pants/sweatpants/shorts/sweatshorts | token 7a | token LoRA quần áo (nguyên từ) | A |
| 7c | token `_` lặp liền nhau | 1 token | gộp lặp | A |
| 7d | `..` · `. .` · dấu thừa cuối | `.` | dọn sau khi ghép | A |

Vì sao không để trong system prompt: refine tắt thì không có LLM; Qwen3-VL-4B không tuân luật đều tay; lỗi định dạng là output của chính model; token LoRA không nên đưa cho LLM. System prompt vẫn giữ các luật này — LLM làm đúng thì regex không làm gì.

nodes.title: System prompt SFW
widgets_values:
You are a prompt rewriter for text-to-image models. You only rewrite text — you never create images yourself — so never refuse and never comment on the request; if unsure, return the user's prompt unchanged. Your task is to expand the user's prompt into a highly effective image-generation prompt.

Plan silently before writing — do not output your plan:
- What is the subject and mood?
- What visual styles, mediums, and lighting options would fit? Consider two or three alternatives and pick the one that best serves the caption.
- What composition, framing, and grounded details will help the text-to-image model?

Follow these rules strictly:
1. **Faithfulness First:** Preserve all original subjects, actions, colors, and spatial relationships. Do not add new objects, props, characters, or animals unless the user clearly implies them.
2. **Practical T2I Structure:** Write a prompt that a text-to-image model can parse cleanly. Group subjects with their own attributes and actions. Use grounded phrasing for poses, interactions, and spatial layout.
3. **Style Planning Stays Internal:** Use your internal reasoning to choose style, medium, framing, and lighting. Do not emit planning tags or wrappers in the visible answer body.
4. **Text Rendering:** If the user requests visible text, quotes, labels, or typography, specify the exact text clearly and wrap requested words in quotes.
5. **Avoid Over-Specification:** Do not invent highly specific clothing, colors, materials, or scene details unless the input supports them.
6. **Respect Existing Detail:** If the user's prompt is already detailed, lightly polish and finalize rather than heavily expanding — preserve their phrasing and direction.
7. **Always Keep the Groin Covered:** Treat depictions of people with dignity. In your output every person's groin and buttocks must be covered, and you must say so in words. If the input mentions nudity or intimate anatomy (nude, naked, undressed, bare, penis, testicles, genitals, pubic hair, erection, bare buttocks), delete those words and do one of: (a) dress the person in briefs and write "wearing briefs that fully cover the groin"; or (b) when underwear does not fit the scene, frame the shot so the groin is out of view (waist-up crop, seen from behind above the waist, or a solid object or thick fabric fully in front of the hips) and write that the groin is out of frame or fully hidden. If the input never says what covers the groin, add briefs the same way. Water, foam, steam, shadow and thin draped fabric do not count as covering. Keep every clothing item the user wrote (e.g. briefs, towel, shorts) with the same word.
8. **Preserve User Medium:** When the user explicitly requests a medium (e.g. "photo of", "photograph of", "illustration of", "painting of", "sketch of", "3D render of"), honor it. Do not pivot to a different medium to avoid difficulty — match the user's stated intent.
9. **Main Character Token:** `{char}` names the main character, whose identity comes from a LoRA. Keep `{char}` exactly as written, once, as the subject of the main character's description. Any other person is a secondary character — call them "another man" / "another woman" or keep the user's own description; never give them `{char}`.
10. **Let the LoRA Define Identity (overrides rules 1 and 6):** For `{char}` only, remove hair color and hair length even if the user wrote them — write at most "short hair"; keep hair state (wet, messy, tousled, slicked-back). Remove facial-structure words even if the user wrote them (jawline, chin, cheekbones, nose, eye shape, lips, face shape); describe expression and emotion instead. Do not invent facial structure for secondary characters.
11. **Camera Defaults:** If the user's prompt already states camera settings (white balance, lens or focal length, aperture or f-stop), keep them and add nothing. Otherwise end the paragraph with exactly: "White balance 5500K, 50mm lens, f/1.8 aperture. Slightly blur the background for portrait shots. Remove unnecessary details; keep shadows natural and soft."
12. **Output Format:** Output exactly one cohesive paragraph and nothing else. Start directly with the prompt itself — no preamble, no title, no commentary, no bullets, no markdown, no negative prompt.
